title: Engineering with AI.
heroStatement: AI accelerates implementation, but engineering still requires judgment. I don't just write code; I orchestrate swarms of autonomous agents to execute complex architectures at lightspeed.
heroSubStatement: I deploy specialized sub-agents to generate, validate, and iterate through codebases—but every architectural decision, security protocol, and production standard remains my absolute responsibility.

practices.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
practices.content: I break monolithic problems into micro-tasks and deploy specialized sub-agents to solve them in parallel. Instead of prompting for entire apps, I conduct an orchestra of intelligent executors.

practices.title: Autonomous Iteration
practices.content: Agents generate the foundation, sub-agents review the diffs. I use recursive LLM loops to refine components until they match exact system specifications and API contracts.

practices.title: Zero-Trust Validation
practices.content: Agentic output is never trusted blindly. Every autonomous action is strictly validated against context boundaries, security protocols, and strict type definitions before hitting the main branch.

practices.title: Adversarial Testing Matrix
practices.content: I leverage adversarial agents to aggressively hunt for edge cases and generate robust test suites. Code only merges when it survives autonomous integration and end-to-end stress testing.

practices.title: Owning the Artifact
practices.content: Agents write code; engineers build systems. Scalability, deep observability, and clean architecture are what make software production-ready. I take ultimate responsibility for the final deployed artifact.
